cd_hit.build: make zlib=no openmp=no (no zlib headers on the box; single-threaded)

build.references: Rfam consensus projections, not structures determined per molecule

predictions.descriptive_user: the ratio held-out corrected / in-sample corrected, with replicates whose in-sample corrected spread is 0 counted as 0 (against the prediction). Descriptive only; this rule replaces any degenerate-case rule
predictions.e3_on_heldout_user: the held-out set folded under the whole Turner 1999, Andronescu 2007 and Langdon 2018 tables: changed fraction and paired dF1 (descriptive)
predictions.main_statistic_user: per set and norm, the NOISE-CORRECTED between-direction spread of mean paired dF1 over the 8 random null directions: corrected = Var_directions(mean dF1) (ddof 1) - mean_directions(SE^2), floored at 0, reported beside the raw spread. SE = bootstrap SD of each direction's mean dF1: over FAMILIES for held-out (cluster bootstrap, sequence-weighted means), over sequences for in-sample (the fold's shards), 2000 draws each
predictions.metrics: per point: paired dF1 against the held-out references, changed-MFE fraction, rms change of held-out reference energies (exact, c(ref).(theta_r - theta_0))
predictions.null_result_user: a null result is reportable: 'real but small'
predictions.published_user: the 3 published null components at their own norms: held-out dF1 with family-bootstrap CIs; no direction predicted
predictions.question_user: do the TR0+TS0 blind spots matter on families bpRNA-1m never contained?
predictions.registered: 2026-10-12, after the held-out set was built (no folding), before any fold
predictions.registered_test_user: at 16 kcal/mol: held-out corrected spread MINUS in-sample corrected spread > 0, joint-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 (families and sequences resampled independently; in each replicate the variance of the replicate means minus the fixed mean SE^2, floored at 0)
predictions.secondary_registered_user: at each norm (4, 16, 64), the number of the 8 null directions whose dF1 95% CI excludes 0, held-out vs in-sample
